title: sound
summary: MSUI has a shared SoundEntries.dbc-driven mixer with weighted variants, no-immediate-repeat, loops/holds, zone/weather and glue-screen music, world ambience, spell/missile audio, broad UI/acquisition cues including the exact character-select/create glue clicks, server-scripted sound, AI-reaction, death, authored fidget/stand/wing, alive-only mount-preferred ambient body loops, melee exertion/injury, client-predicted controlled-unit hard-landing injury, and Emotes/EventSound voices, race/sex-specific SMSG_TEXT_EMOTE voices, exact NPC selection/interaction greeting vocals, GameObject state/event-slot emitters, data-driven self/observed/mount footsteps, authored-timed weapon/natural impacts and defense clangs, the fixed mounted-to-unmounted sound, and material-correct ceremonial weapon draw/stow sounds. Positional voices listen from the character's head/facing (camera pose only in detached free view), use current Benilla's FMOD factor-four inverse rolloff plus strict cutoff/final-ten-percent fade, and project live source direction to per-voice waveOut stereo balance; UI, music and ambience stay centered. Moved units silently arm then play kit 1096 on either crossing of the strict 0.4-collision-height water-depth line, with per-unit overlap suppression. Movement/swimming, water walking, wake, splash, wading footsteps, underwater tint, submerged ambience and portal-destination tint share owner-scoped ADT/MLIQ claims: outdoor subjects read ADT only, interior subjects read only their placed WMO, hidden cells stay dry, owning-group floors bound stacked storeys, the lowest eligible surface wins, and MOGP groupLiquid can submerge a whole room without a grid. Separately, above-water liquid ambience scans all resident wet ADT/MLIQ surfaces around the player, resolves the authored class/speed nibble through SoundWaterType.dbc, prioritizes river then ocean then magma then slime under a two-loop cap, slews near-clamped 3D emitters, crossfades kit changes and radius/priority edges over five seconds, and hard-stops only while submerged in water/ocean. The title theme persists through login/select/create, restarts after natural completion, and fades for two seconds on world entry. Current Benilla's HAL-overload listener and pre-clamp mix tap are developer diagnostics (the former macOS-only), not player audio behavior to port. Interior reverb and unpinned stun/jump vocals remain; observed-unit hard landings depend on the separately tracked inbound movement-relay gap, and non-Windows platforms remain silent.

openItems.text: No zone music or zone/interior ambience (Benilla sound/zone.rs, interior.rs): entering a zone plays nothing; no music/ambience category volumes (Sound Options button is disabled with 'There is no sound subsystem yet' - Program.Settings.cs:636), so the reference CVar defaults (music 0.4, ambience 0.6) have no counterpart.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-14: WorldSoundscape resolves AreaTable/WMO audio through ZoneMusic, ZoneIntroMusicTable, and SoundAmbience; it implements the reference day/night phase, 6-second cold start, 4-second music fade, 5-second ambience crossfade, underwater instant swap, and live music/ambience volume categories.

openItems.text: No footstep audio (sound/footsteps.rs) for self or observed units.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: self, observed units, and mounts now fire only authored $FSD crossings (never per-foot decal tags), resolve display/model-fallback CreatureSoundData footstep class, and join the exact GroundEffectTexture/TerrainType/FootstepTerrainLookup chain. Indoor WMO columns use accepted render faces (MOPY & 0x88 == 0) and MOMT GroundType, with silent ownership instead of falling through to outdoor ADT; wading depth now samples owner-scoped ADT/MLIQ water and selects splash down to 0.75 times the display's CreatureModelData collision height, with deeper water silent. Hover, root-unit CREEP/stealth, and player-ghost states suppress playback. Focused WmoLiquidPoint/Footstep clinical verification and the client build pass.

openItems.text: No weather audio and no SMSG_WEATHER handling at all (sound/weather.rs; opcode absent from Program.Net.cs dispatch).
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: SMSG_WEATHER strict-decodes u32 type, f32 grade, u32 SoundEntries kit, and u8 instant. The retained sound kit replaces outdoor zone ambience, is ignored indoors, yields to underwater audio, and crossfades through the existing five-second ambience transport. Grade remains visual-only.

openItems.text: CreatureSoundData hard-landing injury remains absent; stun/jump start/end columns have no pinned trigger in current Benilla. AI_REACTION, live death/Feign edges, $FD1..4/$FDX/$WNG/$WGG animation vocals, alive-only mount-preferred ambient body loops with out-of-range re-arm, melee $CSS/$CAH/$AH0..3 miss/exertion/contact timing, weapon/natural impacts, defense clangs, and injury vocals are implemented.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: the controlled movement path now latches launch Z on grounded-to-airborne, retains it through the arc, and on landing plays the display-resolved CreatureSoundData normal injury kit only for finite descent strictly greater than 13 yards. The event is immediate client prediction, not SMSG_ENVIRONMENTALDAMAGELOG-driven; flying, NEW_WORLD, teleports/control reseating, and mover changes clear the arc. Focused clinical verification covers the strict boundary and arc edges. Benilla also predicts observed-unit landings from inbound MSG_MOVE relays; MSUI's existing separately registered missing-relay-dispatch gap prevents that broader path without duplicating movement authority here. Stun/jump columns remain intentionally unassigned because current Benilla has no pinned trigger for them.

openItems.text: Emotes.dbc EventSoundID now plays with SMSG_EMOTE one-shots, but the race/sex-specific EmotesTextSound voice selected from SMSG_TEXT_EMOTE remains absent.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: EmotesTextSound.dbc now maps the received text-emote id plus the performer's UNIT_BYTES_0 race/sex descriptor to a positional SFX kit. The server echo covers the controlled player through the same receive path; absent descriptors and voiceless rows remain silent, and loading-cover events are dropped.

openItems.text: No money/coin sounds on loot or coinage change (sound/money.rs) and no item-push pickup cue (SMSG_ITEM_PUSH_RESULT is handled for bags/loot but plays nothing).
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: current Benilla corrected the old triage premise: SMSG_ITEM_PUSH_RESULT is intentionally silent; the per-item pickup cue fires optimistically at the loot-row click. MSUI now matches that exact call site for single, first, and take-all paths via ItemDisplayInfo.groupSoundIndex -> ItemGroupSounds pickup kit, and its PLAYER_FIELD_COINAGE watcher plays LOOTWINDOWCOINSOUND on every post-seed increase or decrease. Focused AcquisitionSound plus LootFrame and InventoryFailure regressions pass.

openItems.text: No mount/dismount audio (sound/mount.rs) and no sheathe/unsheathe weapon sounds (sound/sheathe.rs - MSUI tracks sheath state on the wire but plays no cue).
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: current Benilla refutes the old mount-up premise: attach is silent, while every live mounted-to-unmounted unit plays the fixed positional 'SpiritWolf (DONOTRENAME)' kit and first sight/remount stay silent. Manual Z ceremonies now load SheatheSoundLookups.dbc and play the material-correct draw/stow kit once per occupied melee arm at the delayed hand-swap moment; attack/reactive/remote snaps stay silent.

openItems.text: Interior reverb remains absent (sound/reverb.rs). Above-water SoundWaterType beds are implemented: a distinct unowned sound scan finds the nearest retained wet ADT/MLIQ surface per class within 9 yards of the player, resolves class plus fluid speed through the real 12-row SoundWaterType.dbc, admits at most two classes in River/Ocean/Magma/Slime priority, near-clamps and slews positional emitters, crossfades changes over five seconds, and hard-stops only for water/ocean submersion with instant resurface gain. Interaction queries remain owner-scoped and unchanged. Current Benilla does not apply a separate master underwater-muffling filter.
No GameObject sound emitters (sound/gameobject.rs) and no NPC greeting/farewell voice lines on interaction open/close (sound/greeting.rs).
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: NPC voices now join CreatureDisplayInfo.NPCSoundID to NPCSounds, latch per live creature, follow the exact five-hello/ordered-pissed/wrapping selection sequence, and implement interaction open/swap/close hello-goodbye suppression with despawn stop. GameObjects now silently seed first-seen state, play display Open/Close kits on GO_STATE edges, and fold M2 $GO0..5/$GC0..3 markers into Sound0..9 on the existing dynamic-model timeline, including the fishing-bobber Custom0 event. Both paths are positional SFX and preserve server-event overlap.

openItems.text: No glue-screen (login/character-select) music or UI sounds outside the world session (sound/glue.rs).
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: Added the current wow_main_theme.mp3 glue transport through the shared music category: it starts/restarts across login, character select, and character create, respects live audio settings, and fades for exactly two seconds on the in-world edge. Character select now emits the exact Create New, Delete, Back, Enter World, and delete-dialog cues; the already-present character-create Class/Look/Cancel/Create cues remain on the same pre-world SoundEntries path. Focused GlueAudio and full interface-wire suites pass.

openItems.text: No exploration fanfare - SMSG_EXPLORATION_EXPERIENCE unhandled (sound/zone.rs ExplorationSounds).
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: ExplorationSoundCatalog joins the controlled player's race to ChrRaces.dbc column 3 and plays that SoundEntries kit on every SMSG_EXPLORATION_EXPERIENCE, independent of area-name resolution and XP amount.

openItems.text: Server-scripted SMSG_PLAY_SOUND and SMSG_PLAY_MUSIC are not handled - scripted world moments stay silent.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: SMSG_PLAY_SOUND, SMSG_PLAY_MUSIC, and SMSG_PLAY_OBJECT_SOUND now have exact 4/4/12-byte decoders and dispatch. Sound is 2D SFX; object sound is GUID-positioned 3D with flat fallback; music takes the shared slot, ignores a repeat only while the same kit is live, and fades a displaced track for four seconds. Loading-cover pushes are parsed then dropped rather than deferred.

openItems.text: Backend is Windows-only waveOut PCM; other platforms are observable-but-silent by design (Benilla's mixer plays everywhere a device exists). The reference listener-at-character position/orientation, live positional gain, and stereo-pan behavior are now present on the Windows backend.

Focused SpatialAudio and full interface suites pass. Live-verify character-facing (not orbit-camera-facing) left/right placement, detached free-view camera fallback, moving loop pan, centered UI/music/ambience, factor-four distance rolloff, final-ten-percent cutoff fade, and hard left/right waveOut channel levels.

Focused WaterSplash and full interface suites pass. Live-verify silent first sight, entry and exit crossings at 0.4 times each display's collision height, shallow-step-only behavior below the line, per-unit overlap suppression during spam jumps, remote-unit splashes, and no false ADT-lake splash beneath an owning WMO floor.

Focused WmoLiquidPoint passes. Live-verify Stormwind canal swim/water-walk/wake/entry-exit splash/wading footsteps, camera-eye underwater tint and ambience independent of body room, portal-destination tint, hidden canal-bank cells, no ADT lake bleed inside buildings, repeated WMO placements, no upper-storey pool claim below its owning group floor, and whole-room flooded overrides in Deeprun Tram/Prison Oubliette.

Focused LiquidAmbientLoop, full interface-wire, and full solution builds pass. Live-verify river still/slow/fast transitions, ocean surf at docks, Blackrock/Ironforge lava and Undercity slime, 9-yard player-not-camera trigger, River/Ocean/Magma/Slime priority under the two-loop cap, emitter slew and 5.89-yard near clamp, five-second enter/leave and speed-kit crossfades, hard stop while the eye is below water/ocean, instant resurface restart, no hard stop under magma/slime, and continued layering over zone/weather ambience.
